book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Meyeing wei Laserus o
Ekom inyei tambiy ti lei Laserus eno vanei wong. Moxo nanghei Betani, beyeeng wei Maria luw li vex Marata yo.
Maria tiyon, takwei eno taw wel xeimangou lek Tambiy Ngandoung me vu e vaxa en luvelus, eno li moux Laserus vanei wong me e di yeip.
Om li vex aluw wong qayeeng la wou Yesu bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, moux tiwei wa laleim vind eno vanei wong.”

Ka ingwei Yesu ngo inyon eno moxo neil embei, “Vanei yon se en ingwei xomaxoneing embei mey o. Ma, inyon embei talex Anutu xe nikanzek wou moux alis vex en xel bong e lei na, en kandek xel bong Anutu Neu Moux na qou lei ngandoung is.”
Yesu lalei vind Marata me li vex me Laserus.
Ekom gyeik ingwei moxo ngo bei Laserus vanei wong, eno toundei inyon teyei lek bouk yuw is no.
Woyom moxo neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei, “Xey ambei nox me na Yudia.”
Xel neil embei, “Putoung se ghei denlek ingwei Yudayeiw embei banex wang en qakous o ti, ekom wa being nox me na inyei no?”
Yesu lewexe, “Beip inye se seivma xoumeeng yuw lek bendiyeing ti? Tambiy tiwei mi velewexe bendiyeing eno se mi beng en mi yei tembuing xe xeiyaing.
Ekom gyeik ingwei e velewexe eivek boukeing eno tyek na beng en xeiyaing ma veil e.”
E neil tine dekakom moxo neil wou xel, “Xe xe gweleeng Laserus yeip, ekom ambei na inyei en nana piyexe e.”
E xe xel betiyeing neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei emdi gyeip on tyek bo nimzalek.”
Yesu neil en ingwei e xe meyeing o, ekom e xe xel betiyeing embeik nge Laserus di yeip.
Om moxo neilteyei wou xel bei, “Laserus mey,
de en xam eno a wo xeinglala ngandoung en a se toundei inyei, om tyek xam ghe bongis. Ekom xey ambei na wou e.”
Woyom Tomas (wei xel mi neil Didimas) eno neil wou xel betiyeing valu bei, “Wong xey dalus a la, en nana mey is e yo.”
Yesu qes wei qandieing lek me mapieing o
Gyeik Yesu la eivek Betani eno ngo bei Laserus mey woy me xel ev eivek leiveeng meyeing de bouk vey la veil.
Betani toundei paviy Yerusalem nambei kilomita yayal,
de xel Yudayeiw ngenong lam toundei is Marata luw Maria me byexaxoun luw en ingwei li moux mey o.
Marata ngo bei Yesu lam, eno la myayaing en embei na pelong e, dom Maria toundei eivek xomek.
Marata neil wou Yesu bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei wa toumendei inye nei on tyek a ling se mey.
Ekom gweimbeeng a woulek bei Anutu tyek bong vati wei wambei teling wou e yo.”
Yesu neil wou vexo bei, “Wa lim moux tyek qandi lek no.”
Marata lewexe bei, “A woulek bei moxo tyek qandi lek no eivek bouk loxyus wei xel embei qandi lek o.”
Yesu neil wou vexo bei, “A maxow qandieing lek me mapieing qes. Xelti embei bongis ay eno tyek na toumendei mapieing gyeik e mey o,
de xel eti yeiw wei toundei mapieing me wongis ay eno tyek se teyei bei mey. Beip wang wongis tine?”
Marata neil wou Yesu bei, “Ee, Tambiy Ngandoung, a wongis bei wa Kilisi, Anutu Neu Moux, tambiy tiwei embei nam lek tembuing o.”
Deka Marata neil tine, eno lox me la taxe li Maria la nenyawes. De ngoung wou e, “Putoung lam toundei inye me di teling en wang.”
Maria ngo tine, eno vexo qandi lek daing me la wou Yesu.
Yesu seng ghei la eivek beyeeng, qe nanghei toundei beyeeng wei Marata la pelong e yo.
Xel Yudayeiw wei toundei is Maria eivek xomek me ghanduxoun e, eno yei ingwei vexo qandi lek daing me la myayaing om xel betiy e, xel embeik nge embei na bo talot anghei ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei.
Maria la tyip beyeeng wei Yesu toundei yo me yei e, eno vexo ev vaxakatu eivek wou moxo vaxa me neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei wa toumendei inye nei on tyek a ling moux se mey.”
Yesu yei ingwei vexo eng, me Yudayeiw wei lam is e eno di eng is, om moxo lalei pyaxow me embei deeng.
Moxo teling bei, “Xam ghe liw e nanghei inya?” Xel neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, lam me wei.”
Yesu eng.
Woyom Yudayeiw neil embei, “Xam wei ingwei moxo lalei mi vind e mouyo!”
Ekom xel valu neil embei, “Tambiy tine mi wong xel wei mentekeing eno mi yeila, ekom nambei nya se teyei bei devind tambiy tine veil meyeing?”
Yesu piyexe Laserus veil meyeing
Yesu lalei pyaxow no me la ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei. Inyei eeng wei xel kwelexe eivek qakous me lax mya zeyi yo.
Moxo neil embei, “Xam wo qakous veil.” Marata wei li moux mey eno neil embei, “Ekom Tambiy Ngandoung, tyek bo niliy, en yeip inyon bouk vey la veil o.”
Woyom Yesu neil embei, “Beip a se neil wou wang bei wangwei wang bongis, on tyek wang gwei Anutu xe nikanzek ngandoung?”
Om xel qepei qakous veil. Woyom Yesu veilma lek me neil embei, “Mang, a wong dange wou wang en wang mi ngo ay.
A woulek bei taxombouk eno wang mi ngo ay, ekom a neil inye en nimza wei xomaxoneing wei toungale inye, bei xel bongis bei wang wong a lam.”
Ka Yesu neil tine woy, eno taxe xoulekeing bei, “Laserus, lam myayaing!”
Moux wei mey eno lam myayaing, xel beliv e mema luw me vaxa luw en qaeing de beliv qaeing vivekwou e ma. Yesu neil wou xel “Xam tul qaeing wei leiveeng meyeing eno veil de wong e la.”
Xel tup qayeeng en xel embei nyeis Yesu na mey
Nambei nyon om Yudayeiw ngenong wei lam toundei is Maria, eno yei vati wei Yesu wong, om xel wongis e.
Ekom xel wei xel eno valu la neil wou xel Parisi en vati wei Yesu wong o.
Woyom xel lumuki leitata yo is Parisiyeiw taxe qekueing ama wei kanzol o. Xel teling bei, “Tyek xey a bong ambei nya? Tambiy tine wong dee wei lulvako yo ngenong.
Wangwei xey a bong emdi bong ambei nyon, on tyek xel dalus bongis e. De woyom tyek xel Rom nam lelolexe xe xe xomek vambuing de na qou xomaxoneing wei tembuing ne is.”
Woyom xel wei xel on ti, e lei Kaiapas, moxo wo lumuki lukanzek lek vakovek qes tiyon, eno luk wou xel bei, “Xam lumimpeyei se woulek lulti!
Xam seng woulek bei inye nimza wou xam en ingwei tambiy ti e mey en xomaxoneing dalus enok xel dalus wei tembuing tine eno na mey.”
Moxo se neil inyon nangya kwa, qe wo lumuki lukanzek lek vakovek qes tiyon om neil qayeeng poropet lek ingwei Yesu tyek na mey en xel wei Yudayeiw o,
De se en Yudayeiw venaxow qe en Anutu neuyeiw wei toundei lala yo en embei qeku xel dalus lekti me xel bo tixemou.
Om gyeik bouk kayon me e di la eno xel di luklek sakwaing wei xel embei nyeis Yesu e mey yo.

Nambei nyon om Yesu se lox me la ghavineeng yanyateiv eivek xel Yudayeiw senghoing. Moxo la veil inyon me la beyeeng wei di yeip paviy tembuing bandaing o, la beyeeng wei xel mi neil Epraim nei, me moxo is e xe xel betiyeing la mindei inyon.
Bouk la paviy Yudayeiw xe Pasova, om xel ngenong wei tembuing danghei danghei nei lek me la Yerusalem en embei na bo xow bo vako natax en Pasova.
Xel di yimexe Yesu, deka xel toukale eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing eno xel di teling wouma, “Xam ghe wou naleimim neing bei moxo tyek nam gyei bouk dalus wei Pasova ne?”
Ekom xel lumuki leitata me Parisiyeiw neil wou moux alis vex bei wangwei xelti boulek ingwei Yesu toundei yo, ond e neil wou xel en xel na zeimaxoun e.
